audience: A youth, school, or private baseball coach who records a hitter on a phone and needs to show one concrete correction after practice.
rationale: The title pairs a pronounceable carrier with the job phrase. It is a naming hypothesis, not trademark clearance, and the proposal records the collision uncertainty rather than presenting it as fact.
collisionCheck: UNVERIFIED: the market scan did not search the exact candidate title and no trademark register was queried. Before an owner approves a slot, search Google Play plus USPTO, EUIPO/TMview, WIPO, and the Russian national register for FrameCoach and close variants in class 9. A clean search is not legal clearance.
localisationCheck: INFERRED: the same Latin title is 25 characters in en-US and ru-RU, leaving five characters of slack. Whether Russian-speaking coaches discover it is unmeasured and needs a native-language naming review.
